rows.label: PAYE: monthly pay annualised, taxed on the scale, less the rebate, divided by 12
rows.value: Employers annualise the month's taxable remuneration (after statutory deductions such as ENPF and pension contributions), apply the scale, deduct the E8,200 rebate and divide by 12. Example: E180,000 a year → E41,500 − E8,200 = E33,300 → E2,775 a month. PAYE is remitted by the 7th of the following month.

rows.label: Final Deduction System: PAYE as a final tax for employees
rows.value: Under the Final Deduction System (FDS) the employer deducts PAYE as a final tax; PAYE is remitted monthly by the 7th of the following month.

rows.note: most goods and services supplied in or imported into Eswatini.

rows.label: VAT zero rate: exports and listed basic goods
rows.value: 0% on direct exports and on listed goods, among them animal feeds, fertilisers, seeds, brown bread, maize and maize meal, rice and dairy products.

rows.label: VAT exempt supplies
rows.value: Exempt: financial and insurance services, residential land and buildings and residential letting, education, medical, dental and nursing services, social welfare, betting and gambling, burial, passenger transport (other than by registered tour operators) and sewage services.

rows.label: Excise duties: alcohol, tobacco, road fuels, cars and appliances (SACU tariff)
rows.value: Excise duties apply to alcoholic drinks, tobacco products, road fuels, cars, TVs and refrigerators, as specific or ad valorem duties at the rates in the SACU tariff schedule, at import or domestic manufacture.

sections.title: Freelancers, contractors and the self-employed

rows.label: Presumptive tax: small businesses with turnover below E500,000
rows.note: gross turnover of natural persons or companies in a year of assessment; professionals and recipients of investment income do not qualify.

rows.label: Presumptive tax: turnover up to E50,000
rows.note: gross turnover of a registered small business.

rows.label: Presumptive tax: 1.75% of turnover from E50,000 to E500,000
rows.note: the total gross turnover (not only the excess over E50,000).

rows.label: Presumptive tax: provisional tax in four instalments
rows.value: Small businesses under presumptive tax pay estimated provisional tax in four instalments (25%, 50%, 75% and 100% of the estimated tax by 30 September, 31 December, 31 March and 30 June) and file an annual return.

rows.label: Non-resident contractors: withholding on construction payments
rows.note: payments under construction contracts to persons whose principal place of business is outside Eswatini, excluding the cost of materials; on account of the final liability.

rows.label: Self-employed: provisional tax twice a year and an annual return by 31 October
rows.value: Businesses, including self-employed individuals, pay provisional tax on 31 December and 30 June (a third payment after assessment if short) and file an annual income tax return by 31 October.
